the_question: file-level localisation generalises (17/28 top-1). Line-level has never been measured. Where in the file does the edit go, scored against the lines the real commit touched?

the_gap_that_explains_everything.reading: even when the file is correct, the line is reached in 5 of 16 cases. V38's blind search could not reach the position because the system never had a position to reach. That is the wall, quantified.

rankers_that_were_tried_and_deleted.name: EXCEPTION
rankers_that_were_tried_and_deleted.what: lines near raise/except for the exception type named in the failure
rankers_that_were_tried_and_deleted.measured: a net loss: generic types (TypeError, NotImplementedError, ExceptionGroup) appear on hundreds of lines and the ranker contributed noise

the_one_ranker_that_helped.what: lines inside a function or class the commit message names

what_this_establishes: line-level localisation is not a solved problem at this scale: 1 of 28 top-1 against 17 of 28 for the file. The generation wall V38 found is downstream of this.
what_this_does_not_establish: that no ranker could do better. Three were tried and deleted on measurement; others may exist. No SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench or OSWorld task has been attempted and no benchmark row exists or is claimed.
